build_TRPO_optimizer: build a TRPO optimizer with environment, policy, baseline, and KL distance constraints
train_policy_from_paths: train the TRPO policy using trajectory paths with advantage whitening and backtracking line search
compute_fisher_vector_product: compute the Hessian-vector product using the Fisher information matrix for natural gradient descent
compute_surrogate_objective: compute the constrained policy optimization surrogate objective value before and after policy updates
review_TRPO_backtracking: review the TRPO backtracking line search that reduces step size when KL divergence exceeds the trust region
